name: Airy Clean
description: Airy clean: soft single tube, bright-cap high shelf, open cab 9 kHz — airy, not mid-crush.
script:
# Airy Clean
# How it sounds: Airy clean: soft single tube, bright-cap high shelf, open cab 9 kHz — airy, not mid-crush.
# a Drive: 0.5 to 2.8, default 1.1
# b Bright: 0 to 7, default 3.2
# c Level: 0.55 to 1.45, default 1.1

param a = Drive [0.5, 2.8]
param b = Bright [0.0, 7.0]
param c = Level [0.55, 1.45]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 45; resonance = 0.22 # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5) # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 4800; q = 0.65; gain = b # high shelf
stage2: y = softclip(y, 0.75) * c # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9500; resonance = 0.25 # lowpass

name: Plexi Crunch
description: Plexi bark: dual tube, 750 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), presence shelf, 5.5 kHz cab.
script:
# Plexi Crunch
# How it sounds: Plexi bark: dual tube, 750 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), presence shelf, 5.5 kHz cab.
# a Drive: 1.4 to 7.5, default 3.6
# b Presence: 2000 to 7000, default 3800
# c Level: 0.38 to 1.15, default 0.72

param a = Drive [1.4, 7.5]
param b = Presence [2000, 7000]
param c = Level [0.38, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.38 # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.6) # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.7) # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 750; q = 1.05; gain = 5 # peak EQ
stage3: y = softclip(y * 1.2, 1.45) * c # soft clip
eq2: type = highshelf; freq = b; q = 0.7; gain = 2.8 # high shelf
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5500; resonance = 0.4 # lowpass

name: Mesa High Gain
description: Rectifier wall: tight HPF, triple tube, hard soft-knee ceiling, dark cab — densest amp.
script:
# Mesa High Gain
# How it sounds: Rectifier wall: tight HPF, triple tube, hard soft-knee ceiling, dark cab — densest amp.
# a Gain: 3.5 to 12, default 7.8
# b Tight: 45 to 200, default 85
# c Level: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.42

param a = Gain [3.5, 12.0]
param b = Tight [45, 200]
param c = Level [0.25, 0.9]
gate1: threshold = -46; hyst = 6; hold = 0.03; range = -80  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.6  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.6)  # tube saturation
stage3: y = tube(y, a * 0.45)  # tube saturation
stage4: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.55), 0.68)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4500; resonance = 0.58  # lowpass
stage5: y = diode(y, 1.6) * c  # diode clip
ir1: mix = 0.45; gain = 0  # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08  # limiter

name: Top Boost Chime
description: AC chime: aggressive bass cut, 1.8 kHz peak (top-boost), glassy softclip, open cab.
script:
# Top Boost Chime
# How it sounds: AC chime: aggressive bass cut, 1.8 kHz peak (top-boost), glassy softclip, open cab.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6.5, default 2.9
# b Cut: 280 to 1400, default 520
# c Level: 0.45 to 1.25, default 0.92

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.5]
param b = Cut [280, 1400]
param c = Level [0.45, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5 # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.85) # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1800; q = 1.15; gain = 4.5 # peak EQ
stage2: y = softclip(y * 1.15, 1.5) * c # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8200; resonance = 0.32 # lowpass

name: Mid Boost OD
description: mid-boost OD: ~720 Hz HPF into clipper, then a real 720 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), tone LPF.
script:
# Mid Boost OD
# How it sounds: mid-boost OD: ~720 Hz HPF into clipper, then a real 720 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), tone LPF.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 11, default 5.2
# b Tone: 350 to 4500, default 1800
# c Level: 0.28 to 1.15, default 0.7

param a = Drive [1.2, 11.0]
param b = Tone [350, 4500]
param c = Level [0.28, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 720; resonance = 0.28 # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a) # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 720; q = 1.65; gain = 6 # peak EQ
stage2: y = diode(y * 1.15, 1.3) * c # diode clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.48 # lowpass
ir1: mix = 0.4; gain = 6 # impulse response

name: Transparent Blend
description: Transparent OD: clean path blend + soft diode clip (transparent OD-style clean blend).
script:
# Transparent Blend
# How it sounds: Transparent OD: clean path blend + soft diode clip (transparent OD-style clean blend).
# a Drive: 0.8 to 8, default 3
# b Blend: 0.2 to 0.95, default 0.62
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.3, default 0.9

param a = Drive [0.8, 8.0]
param b = Blend [0.2, 0.95]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.3]
stage1: y = x * c # waveshape / mix
bus dirt:
 send: in = 1 # feed this bus from the input
 filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.3 # highpass
 stage2: y = diode(x, a) * c # diode clip
 eq1: type = peak; freq = 1050; q = 0.85; gain = 3.5 # peak EQ
 filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.3 # lowpass
out: main = 1-b; dirt = b # mix buses back to the output

name: Filter Dist
description: RAT: soft-pre hard ceiling + steep LPF tone (classic filter-after-clip, low alias).
script:
# Filter Dist
# How it sounds: RAT: soft-pre hard ceiling + steep LPF tone (classic filter-after-clip, low alias).
# a Dist: 2 to 12, default 6.5
# b Filter: 300 to 6500, default 1800
# c Level: 0.25 to 1, default 0.58

param a = Dist [2.0, 12.0]
param b = Filter [300, 6500]
param c = Level [0.25, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35 # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.55), 0.55) # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.6 # lowpass
stage2: y = y * c # waveshape / mix

name: Germanium Fuzz
description: Germanium fuzz: bias + soft-pre hard knee + heavy LPF + tube polish (no bare brickwall).
script:
# Germanium Fuzz
# How it sounds: Germanium fuzz: bias + soft-pre hard knee + heavy LPF + tube polish (no bare brickwall).
# a Fuzz: 3 to 16, default 9
# b Tone: 250 to 4500, default 1400
# c Level: 0.15 to 0.85, default 0.42

param a = Fuzz [3.0, 16.0]
param b = Tone [250, 4500]
param c = Level [0.15, 0.85]
gate1: threshold = -44; hyst = 8; hold = 0.04; range = -80 # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 45; resonance = 0.3 # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x + 0.06, a * 0.4), 0.38) # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.7 # lowpass
stage2: y = tube(y, 1.4) * c # tube saturation
ir1: mix = 0.35; gain = 8 # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.1 # limiter

name: Cyberpunk Drive
description: Guitar-shaped digital dirt: HPF, soft preamp, bitcrush, fold, short metal comb, cab LPF. Loud on purpose — not Glitch Laboratory.
script:
# Cyberpunk Drive
# How it sounds: Guitar-shaped digital dirt: HPF, soft preamp, bitcrush, fold, short metal comb, cab LPF. Loud on purpose — not Glitch Laboratory.
# a Drive: 1.8 to 9.5, default 4.6
# b Bits: 5 to 12, default 8.5
# c Fold: 0.22 to 0.68, default 0.4
# d Metal: 5 to 26, default 11
# e Tone: 1400 to 7200, default 4200
# f Level: 0.85 to 1.5, default 1.15

param a = Drive [1.8, 9.5]
param b = Bits [5.0, 12.0]
param c = Fold [0.22, 0.68]
param d = Metal [5, 26]
param e = Tone [1400, 7200]
param f = Level [0.85, 1.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 115; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.5)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1350; q = 0.95; gain = 3.2  # peak EQ
stage2: y = bitcrush(y, b)  # bitcrush
stage3: y = fold(y, -c, c)  # wavefold
delay1: time = d; feedback = 0.34; mix = 0.16; damp = 6800  # delay line
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.38  # lowpass
stage4: y = diode(y, 1.32) * f * 1.35  # diode clip

name: Classic Tremolo
description: Opto-style sine tremolo. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16), one cycle per note.
script:
# Classic Tremolo
# How it sounds: Opto-style sine tremolo. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16), one cycle per note.
# a Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.4
# b Depth: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.5
# c Floor: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.2, 0.85]
param c = Floor [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))  # waveshape / mix

name: Chopper
description: Soft-square trem chopper. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16). Dynamics preserved (floor).
script:
# Chopper
# How it sounds: Soft-square trem chopper. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16). Dynamics preserved (floor).
# a Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.45
# b Depth: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.55
# c Floor: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.25, 0.85]
param c = Floor [0.15, 0.55]
osc1: shape = softsquare; sync = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))  # waveshape / mix

name: Optical Vibe
description: Vibe-ish: dual path AM with slow LFO and soft saturation.
script:
# Optical Vibe
# How it sounds: Vibe-ish: dual path AM with slow LFO and soft saturation.
# a Rate: 0.15 to 6, default 1.1
# b Depth: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.55
# c Drive: 1 to 3, default 1.6

param a = Rate [0.15, 6.0]
param b = Depth [0.2, 0.85]
param c = Drive [1.0, 3.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0 # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, c) # tube saturation
stage2: y = y * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)) # waveshape / mix

name: Chorus Delay
description: Real short delay chorus + dual-rate LFO thickness — not fake AM-only chorus.
script:
# Chorus Delay
# How it sounds: Real short delay chorus + dual-rate LFO thickness — not fake AM-only chorus.
# a Rate: 0.25 to 3.5, default 1.05
# b Depth: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.32
# c Time: 8 to 32, default 18
# d Mix: 0.18 to 0.55, default 0.34

param a = Rate [0.25, 3.5]
param b = Depth [0.12, 0.5]
param c = Time [8, 32]
param d = Mix [0.18, 0.55]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
osc2: shape = sine; freq = a * 1.31; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, 1.35)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = c; feedback = 0.14; mix = d; damp = 9500  # delay line
stage2: y = softclip(y * (1.0 - b + b * 0.5 * ((0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc2))), 1.08)  # soft clip

name: Low Pass Sweep
description: Musical LFO lowpass: cutoff walks Min to Min+Depth (never Min-Depth). Rate is a note grid.
script:
# Low Pass Sweep
# How it sounds: Musical LFO lowpass: cutoff walks Min to Min+Depth (never Min-Depth). Rate is a note grid.
# a Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.45
# b Min: 180 to 800, default 420
# c Depth: 400 to 5000, default 2400
# d Res: 0.4 to 3, default 1.4

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Min [180, 800]
param c = Depth [400, 5000]
param d = Res [0.4, 3.0]
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * c; resonance = d  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, 1.08)  # diode clip

name: Bandpass Vocal
description: Formant-ish bandpass for vocal/synth body.
script:
# Bandpass Vocal
# How it sounds: Formant-ish bandpass for vocal/synth body.
# a Center: 350 to 2800, default 950
# b Width: 100 to 1000, default 380
# c Drive: 0.9 to 2.8, default 1.5

param a = Center [350, 2800]
param b = Width [100, 1000]
param c = Drive [0.9, 2.8]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = b  # bandpass
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip

name: Transient Bite
description: Peak envelope boosts softclip drive on attacks + mild AA LPF.
script:
# Transient Bite
# How it sounds: Peak envelope boosts softclip drive on attacks + mild AA LPF.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 2.8
# b Attack: 0.001 to 0.015, default 0.003
# c Release: 0.02 to 0.2, default 0.07
# d Amount: 0.25 to 0.95, default 0.65

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.0]
param b = Attack [0.001, 0.015]
param c = Release [0.02, 0.2]
param d = Amount [0.25, 0.95]
env1: type = peak; attack = b; release = c  # envelope follower
stage1: y = softclip(x * (a + env1 * a * d), 1.0)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Metal Gate
description: Tight metal: HPF â†’ tube cascade â†’ soft-pre hard knee â†’ cab LPF (filter after clip).
script:
# Metal Gate
# How it sounds: Tight metal: HPF → tube cascade → soft-pre hard knee → cab LPF, then width.
# a Drive: 4 to 14, default 8.5
# b LowCut: 70 to 350, default 140
# c Level: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.45
# d Width: 0 to 1.2, default 0.55

param a = Drive [4.0, 14.0]
param b = LowCut [70, 350]
param c = Level [0.2, 0.85]
param d = Width [0.0, 1.2]
gate1: threshold = -38; hyst = 8; attack = 0.004; hold = 0.08; release = 0.12; range = -80  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.45)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(tube(y, a * 0.5), 1.1), 0.5)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4800; resonance = 0.6  # lowpass
stage3: y = y * c  # waveshape / mix
ir1: mix = 0.5; gain = 0  # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08  # limiter
widen1: width = d  # mono to stereo

name: Vocal Grit
description: Broadcast grit: HPF, tube, air LPF.
script:
# Vocal Grit
# How it sounds: Broadcast grit: HPF, tube, air LPF.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 5.5, default 2.6
# b LowCut: 80 to 280, default 130
# c Air: 2500 to 11000, default 7000
# d Level: 0.5 to 1.25, default 0.92

param a = Drive [1.2, 5.5]
param b = LowCut [80, 280]
param c = Air [2500, 11000]
param d = Level [0.5, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a) * d  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Radio Voice
description: AM radio bandpass + softclip + light bitcrush + LPF (quantize always filtered).
script:
# Radio Voice
# How it sounds: AM radio bandpass + softclip + light bitcrush + LPF (quantize always filtered).
# a Center: 500 to 2200, default 1050
# b Width: 180 to 900, default 420
# c Drive: 1.2 to 4, default 2.2

param a = Center [500, 2200]
param b = Width [180, 900]
param c = Drive [1.2, 4.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = b  # bandpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip
stage2: y = bitcrush(y, 10)  # bitcrush
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Vocal Comp
description: Vocal bus compressor + soft ceiling.
script:
# Vocal Comp
# How it sounds: Vocal bus compressor + soft ceiling.
# a Threshold: -28 to -8, default -14
# b Ratio: 2.5 to 10, default 5
# c Drive: 1 to 2.5, default 1.35

param a = Threshold [-28.0, -8.0]
param b = Ratio [2.5, 10.0]
param c = Drive [1.0, 2.5]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.005; release = 0.12  # compressor
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip

name: Whisper Edge
description: Airy HPF into soft tube.
script:
# Whisper Edge
# How it sounds: Airy HPF into soft tube.
# a Drive: 1.1 to 3.5, default 1.9
# b HPF: 250 to 1100, default 480
# c Level: 0.55 to 1.35, default 1

param a = Drive [1.1, 3.5]
param b = HPF [250, 1100]
param c = Level [0.55, 1.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.55  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a) * c  # tube saturation

name: Doubler AM
description: Short slap double with mild AM on delay time + diode grit.
script:
# Doubler AM
# How it sounds: Short slap double with mild AM on delay time + diode grit.
# a Time: 12 to 42, default 22
# b Mix: 0.18 to 0.55, default 0.32
# c Drive: 1 to 2.2, default 1.3
# d Rate: 0.2 to 4, default 1.4

param a = Time [12, 42]
param b = Mix [0.18, 0.55]
param c = Drive [1.0, 2.2]
param d = Rate [0.2, 4.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = d; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip
delay1: time = a + osc1 * 4; feedback = 0.08; mix = b; damp = 7000  # delay line
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Acid Line
description: 303-ish: env opens LPF with musical Q, then diode.
script:
# Acid Line
# How it sounds: 303-ish: env opens LPF with musical Q, then diode.
# a Res: 0.8 to 2.6, default 1.9
# b Min: 90 to 500, default 180
# c Range: 500 to 4500, default 2400
# d Drive: 1.1 to 4, default 2

param a = Res [0.8, 2.6]
param b = Min [90, 500]
param c = Range [500, 4500]
param d = Drive [1.1, 4.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.004; release = 0.16  # envelope follower
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; + = env1; * = c; resonance = a  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, d)  # diode clip

name: Sidechain Pump
description: Sine ducking envelope (sidechain pump). Rate is note-grid: 1/4 at 120 BPM = 2 Hz, not milliseconds-as-Hz.
script:
# Sidechain Pump
# How it sounds: Sine ducking envelope (sidechain pump). Rate is note-grid: 1/4 at 120 BPM = 2 Hz, not milliseconds-as-Hz.
# a Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.45
# b Depth: 0.4 to 1, default 0.85
# c Floor: 0 to 0.35, default 0.08

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.4, 1.0]
param c = Floor [0.0, 0.35]
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))  # waveshape / mix

name: Shimmer Drive
description: Tube drive into a bright high-passed hall; slow AM on the tail.
script:
# Shimmer Drive
# How it sounds: Tube drive into a bright high-passed hall; slow AM on the tail.
# a Drive: 1 to 3.2, default 1.7
# b Size: 0.35 to 0.9, default 0.62
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.42
# d Rate: 0.05 to 1.2, default 0.18
# e Depth: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.32
# f Damp: 0.15 to 0.65, default 0.38

param a = Drive [1.0, 3.2]
param b = Size [0.35, 0.9]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.7]
param d = Rate [0.05, 1.2]
param e = Depth [0.12, 0.5]
param f = Damp [0.15, 0.65]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = d; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
bus shine:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.78; damp = f; mix = 1; width = 0.95  # reverb
  stage2: y = x * (1.0 - e + e * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 1800; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; shine = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Wide Motion
description: Opposite-phase AM L/R for width.

name: Formant Crush
description: Dual formant peaks + softclip + mild LPF (clip between formants stays band-limited).
script:
# Formant Crush
# How it sounds: Dual formant peaks + softclip + mild LPF (clip between formants stays band-limited).
# a F1: 320 to 1100, default 580
# b F2: 1000 to 2800, default 1500
# c Drive: 1.3 to 4.5, default 2.4

param a = F1 [320, 1100]
param b = F2 [1000, 2800]
param c = Drive [1.3, 4.5]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 220  # bandpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip
filter2: type = bandpass; center = b; width = 320  # bandpass
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Comb Taste
description: Metallic comb via very short delay + high feedback (true delay line, not y_prev).
script:
# Comb Taste
# How it sounds: Metallic comb via very short delay + high feedback (true delay line, not y_prev).
# a Time: 3 to 28, default 11
# b Feedback: 0.55 to 0.9, default 0.72
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.55
# d Drive: 1 to 2.8, default 1.5

param a = Time [3, 28]
param b = Feedback [0.55, 0.9]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
param d = Drive [1.0, 2.8]
stage1: y = tube(x, d)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 7000  # delay line
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 10000; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Preamp Regen Stack
description: HPF -> tube (SIMD) -> ONE y_prev regen stage -> cab LPF -> soft power (SIMD). Fast multi-stage.
script:
# Preamp Regen Stack
# How it sounds: HPF -> tube (SIMD) -> ONE y_prev regen stage -> cab LPF -> soft power (SIMD). Fast multi-stage.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 7, default 3.4
# b Regen: 0.08 to 0.48, default 0.28
# c Tone: 800 to 6500, default 3200
# d Level: 0.35 to 1.15, default 0.8

param a = Drive [1.2, 7.0]
param b = Regen [0.08, 0.48]
param c = Tone [800, 6500]
param d = Level [0.35, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.4)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.45  # lowpass
stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.15) * d  # soft clip

name: Slapback Drive
description: Touch-sensitive OD into a real short delay slap (80–140 ms), damped feedback, diode polish.
script:
# Slapback Drive

script:
# Stereo Guitar Wall
# How it sounds: Two amps from one mono DI: left dense American (dark, dense), right tight-lead (tight presence). Works with a mono guitar in (silent side is copied).
# a GainL: 3.5 to 12, default 7.6
# b GainR: 3.5 to 12, default 7.2
# c Tight: 55 to 200, default 95
# d Presence: 2800 to 7000, default 4800
# e Level: 0.28 to 0.95, default 0.52

param a = GainL [3.5, 12.0]
param b = GainR [3.5, 12.0]
param c = Tight [55, 200]
param d = Presence [2800, 7000]
param e = Level [0.28, 0.95]
gate1: threshold = -46; hyst = 7; hold = 0.03; range = -80  # noise gate
split1: type = leftright {
  left {
    filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.55  # highpass
    stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
    stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.58)  # tube saturation
    eq1: type = peak; freq = 780; q = 1.05; gain = 3.8  # peak EQ
    stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.5), 0.68)  # soft clip
    filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4500; resonance = 0.52  # lowpass
    stage4: y = diode(y, 1.5) * e  # diode clip
  }
  right {
    filter3: type = highpass; cutoff = c * 1.12; resonance = 0.58  # highpass
    stage5: y = tube(x, b * 0.46)  # tube saturation
    stage6: y = tube(y, b * 0.55)  # tube saturation
    eq2: type = highshelf; freq = d; q = 0.7; gain = 3.6  # high shelf
    stage7: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.48), 0.7)  # soft clip
    filter4: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4200; resonance = 0.48  # lowpass
    stage8: y = diode(y, 1.48) * e  # diode clip
  }
}
ir1: mix = 0.5; gain = 0  # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08  # limiter

param c = Center [400, 4000]

param e = Mix [0.25, 0.95]

osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix

  stage2: y = softclip(x, d)  # soft clip

name: Large Hall
description: large hall hall habit: size 0.76–0.94, decay 0.62–0.88, damp 0.38–0.56, predelay 20–80 ms, full width. Even, long, not a plate.
script:
# Large Hall
# How it sounds: large hall hall habit: size 0.76–0.94, decay 0.62–0.88, damp 0.38–0.56, predelay 20–80 ms, full width. Even, long, not a plate.
# a Size: 0.76 to 0.94, default 0.84
# b Decay: 0.62 to 0.88, default 0.74
# c Predelay: 20 to 80, default 36
# d Damp: 0.38 to 0.56, default 0.46
# e Mix: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.3

param a = Size [0.76, 0.94]
param b = Decay [0.62, 0.88]
param c = Predelay [20, 80]
param d = Damp [0.38, 0.56]
param e = Mix [0.12, 0.5]
delay1: time = c; feedback = 0.04; mix = 0.3; damp = 8500 # delay line
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = d; mix = e; width = 1.0 # reverb
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 55; resonance = 0.2 # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.04) # soft clip

name: Nonlinear Snap
description: nonlinear16 NonLin2 habit: 150–350 ms dense burst. Fixed room (no live size jumps), darker damp, short slap, recovery LPF. 80s snare room, not a hall.
script:
# Nonlinear Snap
# How it sounds: nonlinear16 NonLin2 habit: 150–350 ms dense burst. Fixed room (no live size jumps), darker damp, short slap, recovery LPF. 80s snare room, not a hall.
# a Burst: 0.18 to 0.34, default 0.24
# b Predelay: 10 to 26, default 16
# c Damp: 0.32 to 0.55, default 0.42
# d Mix: 0.18 to 0.62, default 0.4

param a = Burst [0.18, 0.34]
param b = Predelay [10, 26]
param c = Damp [0.32, 0.55]
param d = Mix [0.18, 0.62]
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.02; mix = 0.12; damp = 5500 # delay line
reverb1: size = 0.36; decay = a; damp = c; mix = d; width = 0.68 # reverb
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 3800; q = 0.65; gain = 1.1 # high shelf
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.22 # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9500; resonance = 0.22 # lowpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.04) # soft clip

name: Spring Tank
description: Guitar-amp / AKG-ish spring: small tank, splashy top, 22–40 ms drip delay, decay 0.26–0.48, damp 0.16–0.3. Not a plate and not a hall.
script:
# Spring Tank
# How it sounds: Guitar-amp / AKG-ish spring: small tank, splashy top, 22–40 ms drip delay, decay 0.26–0.48, damp 0.16–0.3. Not a plate and not a hall.
# a Decay: 0.26 to 0.48, default 0.36
# b Drip: 22 to 40, default 30
# c Splash: 0.16 to 0.3, default 0.22
# d Mix: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.3
# e Drive: 0.9 to 2.2, default 1.25

param a = Decay [0.26, 0.48]
param b = Drip [22, 40]
param c = Splash [0.16, 0.3]
param d = Mix [0.12, 0.55]
param e = Drive [0.9, 2.2]
stage1: y = tube(x, e)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.22; damp = 7000  # delay line
reverb1: size = 0.24; decay = a; damp = c; mix = d; width = 0.45  # reverb
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2100; q = 1.4; gain = 2.6  # peak EQ
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 120; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.08)  # soft clip

name: FET Peak Catch
description: Insert on a lead vocal. Fast FET catches peaks. Mix 100.
script:
# FET Peak Catch
# How it sounds: Insert on a lead vocal. Fast FET catches peaks. Mix 100.
# a Drive: 2 to 10, default 5.5
# b Attack: 0.0002 to 0.008, default 0.001
# c Release: 0.04 to 0.28, default 0.09

param a = Drive [2, 10]
param b = Attack [0.0002, 0.008]
param c = Release [0.04, 0.28]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 8; attack = b; release = c; knee = 2; makeup = 3  # compressor
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3200; q = 1.1; gain = 1.8  # peak EQ

name: Opto Leveler
description: Insert after a peak catcher. Slow opto rides the level. Mix 100.
script:
# Opto Leveler
# How it sounds: Insert after a peak catcher. Slow opto rides the level. Mix 100.
# a Pull: 4 to 14, default 8
# b Makeup: 0 to 8, default 2.5
# c Air: 0 to 5, default 2.2

param a = Pull [4, 14]
param b = Makeup [0, 8]
param c = Air [0, 5]
stage1: y = tube(x, 0.85)  # tube saturation
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 3; attack = 0.012; release = 0.22; knee = 8; makeup = b  # compressor
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 9000; q = 0.6; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Serial Vocal Stack
description: Classic FET into opto on one insert. Lead vocal, Mix 100.
script:
# Serial Vocal Stack
# How it sounds: Classic FET into opto on one insert. Lead vocal, Mix 100.
# a Peak: 3 to 12, default 6
# b Ride: 4 to 12, default 7
# c Air: 0 to 4, default 1.6

param a = Peak [3, 12]
param b = Ride [4, 12]
param c = Air [0, 4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 8; attack = 0.0008; release = 0.07; knee = 1; makeup = 2  # compressor
comp2: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.015; release = 0.25; knee = 10; makeup = 2  # compressor
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 10000; q = 0.55; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Rap Punch Chain
description: Rap vocal insert: 80 Hz cut, fast FET, de-ess on the air band. Mix 100.
script:
# Rap Punch Chain
# How it sounds: Rap vocal insert: 80 Hz cut, fast FET, de-ess on the air band. Mix 100.
# a Punch: 3 to 12, default 7
# b Ess: 2 to 10, default 5
# c Presence: 0 to 5, default 2

param a = Punch [3, 12]
param b = Ess [2, 10]
param c = Presence [0, 5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 12; attack = 0.0004; release = 0.05; knee = 1; makeup = 3  # compressor
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2800; q = 1.2; gain = c  # peak EQ
xover1: f1 = 4200; f2 = 9000  # crossover
bus high:
  comp2: threshold = -b; ratio = 6; attack = 0.001; release = 0.04; makeup = 0  # compressor
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: De-Ess Shelf
description: Insert de-ess: only the top band is compressed. Mix 100.
script:
# De-Ess Shelf
# How it sounds: Insert de-ess: only the top band is compressed. Mix 100.
# a Ess: 3 to 14, default 7
# b BandHz: 3500 to 8000, default 5200
# c Air: 0 to 3, default 0.8

param a = Ess [3, 14]
param b = BandHz [3500, 8000]
param c = Air [0, 3]
xover1: f1 = b; f2 = 11000  # crossover
bus high:
  comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 8; attack = 0.0006; release = 0.035; makeup = 0  # compressor
  eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Slap And Booth
description: Vocal send: 95 ms slap plus a small booth. Blend is wet. Mix 25–40 on a send.
script:
# Slap And Booth
# How it sounds: Vocal send: 95 ms slap plus a small booth. Blend is wet. Mix 25–40 on a send.
# a Slap: 70 to 140, default 95
# b Room: 0.12 to 0.42, default 0.22
# c Blend: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.32

param a = Slap [70, 140]
param b = Room [0.12, 0.42]
param c = Blend [0.15, 0.7]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus wet:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.08; mix = 1; damp = 4500  # delay line
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.22; damp = 0.55; mix = 1; width = 0.45  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; wet = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Dotted Eighth Throw
description: Pop vocal throw. Dotted 1/8, dark. Use as a send, Mix 20–35.
script:
# Dotted Eighth Throw
# How it sounds: Pop vocal throw. Dotted 1/8, dark. Use as a send, Mix 20–35.
# a Feedback: 0.12 to 0.48, default 0.26
# b Tone: 1800 to 6500, default 3800
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Feedback [0.12, 0.48]
param b = Tone [1800, 6500]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.55]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus throw:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
  delay1: time = 1/8.; feedback = a; mix = 1; damp = b  # delay line
out: main = 1-c; throw = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Quarter Note Halo
description: Ballad vocal send. Straight 1/4, wider and wetter than the dotted throw.
script:
# Quarter Note Halo
# How it sounds: Ballad vocal send. Straight 1/4, wider and wetter than the dotted throw.
# a Feedback: 0.18 to 0.52, default 0.3
# b Size: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.34
# c Blend: 0.15 to 0.6, default 0.3

param a = Feedback [0.18, 0.52]
param b = Size [0.2, 0.55]
param c = Blend [0.15, 0.6]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus halo:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = 1/4; feedback = a; mix = 1; damp = 4200  # delay line
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.45; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.35; width = 0.7  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; halo = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Dual Throw Lattice
description: Two throws: dotted 1/8 left-ish and 1/4. Pop chorus send.
script:
# Dual Throw Lattice
# How it sounds: Two throws: dotted 1/8 left-ish and 1/4. Pop chorus send.
# a Short: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2
# b Long: 0.12 to 0.45, default 0.24
# c Blend: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.3

param a = Short [0.1, 0.4]
param b = Long [0.12, 0.45]
param c = Blend [0.15, 0.55]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus short:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = 1/8.; feedback = a; mix = 1; damp = 5000  # delay line
bus long:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay2: time = 1/4; feedback = b; mix = 1; damp = 3600  # delay line
out: main = 1-c; short = c*0.55; long = c*0.45  # mix buses back to the output

name: Radio Band Vocal
description: AM radio vocal. Tight band, light crush, then LPF. Insert or send.
script:
# Radio Band Vocal
# How it sounds: AM radio vocal. Tight band, light crush, then LPF. Insert or send.
# a Bits: 5 to 11, default 8
# b Center: 800 to 2200, default 1400
# c Width: 400 to 1400, default 800

param a = Bits [5, 11]
param b = Center [800, 2200]
param c = Width [400, 1400]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = b; width = c  # bandpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.4), a)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4500; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Telephone Cup
description: Narrower than Radio Band. 400–3 kHz cup, diode grit.
script:
# Telephone Cup
# How it sounds: Narrower than Radio Band. 400–3 kHz cup, diode grit.
# a Grit: 0.8 to 3.5, default 1.6
# b Low: 280 to 700, default 400
# c High: 2200 to 4200, default 3000

param a = Grit [0.8, 3.5]
param b = Low [280, 700]
param c = High [2200, 4200]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.45  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip

name: Haas Vocal Double
description: Mono vocal to a tight double. Mid stays the dry word. Insert, Mix 100.
script:
# Haas Vocal Double
# How it sounds: Mono vocal to a tight double. Mid stays the dry word. Insert, Mix 100.
# a Offset: 8 to 28, default 16
# b Width: 0.3 to 1, default 0.62
# c High: 4000 to 10000, default 7500

param a = Offset [8, 28]
param b = Width [0.3, 1]
param c = High [4000, 10000]
widen1: width = b; delay = a; bass = 140  # mono to stereo
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = c; q = 0.55; gain = 1.4  # high shelf

name: Air Only Vocal
description: Add air without more compression. High shelf + tiny tube. Insert.
script:
# Air Only Vocal
# How it sounds: Add air without more compression. High shelf + tiny tube. Insert.
# a Air: 1 to 8, default 3.4
# b Warm: 0.4 to 1.6, default 0.75
# c LowCut: 40 to 140, default 70

param a = Air [1, 8]
param b = Warm [0.4, 1.6]
param c = LowCut [40, 140]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, b)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 11000; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf

name: Presence Pocket
description: 3 kHz pocket so the lyric cuts a dense mix. Light glue after.
script:
# Presence Pocket
# How it sounds: 3 kHz pocket so the lyric cuts a dense mix. Light glue after.
# a Cut: 0 to 6, default 2.8
# b Glue: 2 to 8, default 4.5
# c Dip: 200 to 500, default 320

param a = Cut [0, 6]
param b = Glue [2, 8]
param c = Dip [200, 500]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3100; q = 1.35; gain = a  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = c; q = 1.1; gain = -2.2  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.006; release = 0.12; makeup = 1.5  # compressor

name: Breath Gate
description: Close-mic vocal. Gate the breaths, keep the line. Mix 100.
script:
# Breath Gate
# How it sounds: Close-mic vocal. Gate the breaths, keep the line. Mix 100.
# a Open: -56 to -28, default -42
# b Hold: 0.02 to 0.16, default 0.06
# c Range: -70 to -20, default -48

param a = Open [-56, -28]
param b = Hold [0.02, 0.16]
param c = Range [-70, -20]
gate1: threshold = a; hyst = 5; hold = b; range = c  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 8000; q = 0.55; gain = 1.2  # high shelf

name: Choir Widen Hall
description: Stack or choir. Width then a long hall on a send blend.
script:
# Choir Widen Hall
# How it sounds: Stack or choir. Width then a long hall on a send blend.
# a Width: 0.25 to 1, default 0.55
# b Hall: 0.35 to 0.75, default 0.55
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.24

param a = Width [0.25, 1]
param b = Hall [0.35, 0.75]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.5]
widen1: delay = 14; mix = a  # mono to stereo
bus hall:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.6; damp = 0.42; mix = 1; width = 0.85  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; hall = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Shout Clip Vocal
description: Screamed / shouted vocal. HPF, soft-pre hard ceiling, dark recovery.
script:
# Shout Clip Vocal
# How it sounds: Screamed / shouted vocal. HPF, soft-pre hard ceiling, dark recovery.
# a Drive: 1.4 to 6, default 2.8
# b Ceiling: 0.35 to 0.85, default 0.58
# c Tone: 2500 to 7000, default 4800

param a = Drive [1.4, 6]
param b = Ceiling [0.35, 0.85]
param c = Tone [2500, 7000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 140; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), b)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass

name: Narration Seat
description: Spoken word / VO. Gentle EQ, slow leveler, peak limit. Mix 100.
script:
# Narration Seat
# How it sounds: Spoken word / VO. Gentle EQ, slow leveler, peak limit. Mix 100.
# a Body: 0 to 4, default 1.6
# b Ride: 3 to 10, default 6
# c Ceiling: -3 to -0.2, default -0.8

param a = Body [0, 4]
param b = Ride [3, 10]
param c = Ceiling [-3, -0.2]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 180; q = 0.8; gain = a  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 4500; q = 0.9; gain = 1.2  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 2.5; attack = 0.02; release = 0.3; knee = 10; makeup = 1  # compressor
limit1: ceiling = c; release = 0.12  # limiter

name: Mid Word Side Bloom
description: MS vocal: mid stays dry words, sides get a short bloom.
script:
# Mid Word Side Bloom
# How it sounds: MS vocal: mid stays dry words, sides get a short bloom.
# a Bloom: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# b Size: 0.18 to 0.45, default 0.28
# c Width: 0.4 to 1, default 0.7

param a = Bloom [0.15, 0.5]
param b = Size [0.18, 0.45]
param c = Width [0.4, 1]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x  # waveshape / mix
stage2: channel = side; y = x  # waveshape / mix
reverb1: channel = side; size = b; decay = a; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.55; width = c  # reverb
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Vocal Plate Throw
description: Short bright plate on a send. Not a hall.
script:
# Vocal Plate Throw
# How it sounds: Short bright plate on a send. Not a hall.
# a Size: 0.12 to 0.38, default 0.22
# b Decay: 0.18 to 0.55, default 0.32
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.26

param a = Size [0.12, 0.38]
param b = Decay [0.18, 0.55]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.5]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus plate:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 220; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
  reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.35; mix = 1; width = 0.72  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; plate = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Side Air Only
description: MS: lift air on the sides only. Center stays put.
script:
# Side Air Only
# How it sounds: MS: lift air on the sides only. Center stays put.
# a Air: 1 to 7, default 3.2
# b AirHz: 5000 to 12000, default 8500
# c SideGain: 0.7 to 1.3, default 1

param a = Air [1, 7]
param b = AirHz [5000, 12000]
param c = SideGain [0.7, 1.3]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x  # waveshape / mix
eq1: channel = side; type = highshelf; freq = b; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf
stage2: channel = side; y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Parallel Vocal Smash
description: NY vocal: dry word plus a smashed bus. Blend is the smash.
script:
# Parallel Vocal Smash
# How it sounds: NY vocal: dry word plus a smashed bus. Blend is the smash.
# a Smash: 4 to 14, default 8
# b Tone: 2000 to 7000, default 4500
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Smash [4, 14]
param b = Tone [2000, 7000]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.55]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus smash:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
  stage2: y = tube(x, 2.2)  # tube saturation
  comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 12; attack = 0.0005; release = 0.08; makeup = 6  # compressor
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; smash = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Track Then Slap
description: Insert EQ/comp plus a dedicated slap send in one preset.
script:
# Track Then Slap
# How it sounds: Insert EQ/comp plus a dedicated slap send in one preset.
# a Glue: 3 to 10, default 5.5
# b Slap: 70 to 130, default 98
# c Send: 0.08 to 0.4, default 0.18

param a = Glue [3, 10]
param b = Slap [70, 130]
param c = Send [0.08, 0.4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3500; q = 1.05; gain = 1.6  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 4; attack = 0.003; release = 0.1; makeup = 2  # compressor
bus slap:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.06; mix = 1; damp = 5000  # delay line
out: main = 1; slap = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Talk Formant
description: Envelope moves a bandpass so the mouth shape talks. Creative insert.
script:
# Talk Formant
# How it sounds: Envelope moves a bandpass so the mouth shape talks. Creative insert.
# a Depth: 200 to 1600, default 700
# b Center: 700 to 1800, default 1100
# c Mix: 0.2 to 1, default 0.55

param a = Depth [200, 1600]
param b = Center [700, 1800]
param c = Mix [0.2, 1]
env1: attack = 0.008; release = 0.09  # envelope follower
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus mouth:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = b + env1 * a; width = 650; resonance = 1.4  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; mouth = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Widen Then Slap
description: Double first, then a short slap on the wide image.
script:
# Widen Then Slap
# How it sounds: Double first, then a short slap on the wide image.
# a Width: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.5
# b Slap: 60 to 120, default 88
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.22

param b = Slap [60, 120]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.55]
widen1: delay = 12; mix = a  # mono to stereo

name: Air Band Polish
description: Crossover: compress the air band and add a silk shelf there only.
script:
# Air Band Polish
# How it sounds: Crossover: compress the air band and add a silk shelf there only.
# a Silk: 0 to 5, default 2.2
# b Pull: 2 to 10, default 5
# c AirHz: 6000 to 11000, default 8000

param a = Silk [0, 5]

xover1: f1 = 250; f2 = c  # crossover
bus mid:
  eq2: type = peak; freq = 1800; q = 0.8; gain = 0.6  # peak EQ
bus high:
  comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.004; release = 0.08; makeup = 1  # compressor
  eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.45; gain = a  # high shelf
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Pop Lead Desk
description: Full pop insert: HPF, FET, de-ess, slap send. Mix 100, send is built in.
script:
# Pop Lead Desk

# c Throw: 0.08 to 0.35, default 0.16

param a = Peak [3, 11]
param b = Ess [3, 12]
param c = Throw [0.08, 0.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.24  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 6; attack = 0.001; release = 0.08; makeup = 2.5  # compressor
xover1: f1 = 4800; f2 = 9500  # crossover
bus high:
