eq1: type = peak; freq = 200; q = 0.85; gain = b # peak EQ
stage1: y = tube(x, a) # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3200; resonance = 0.32 # lowpass
ir1: mix = c; gain = 1 # impulse response

name: Sub Only Octave
description: Just the analog sub, no dry. Bass / guitar. Mix to taste in the host.
script:
# Sub Only Octave
# How it sounds: Just the analog sub, no dry. Bass / guitar. Mix to taste in the host.
# a Tone: 80 to 400, default 280
# b Level: 0.3 to 1.2, default 1.1
# c Low: 30 to 80, default 45

param a = Tone [80, 400]
param b = Level [0.3, 1.2]
param c = Low [30, 80]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
octaver1: mix = 1; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = a; thresh = 0.03  # analog octaver
stage1: y = x * b * 3.2  # makeup
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 400; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Octave Into Dirt
description: Octave then diode. Synth-bass / riff.
script:
# Octave Into Dirt
# How it sounds: Octave then diode. Synth-bass / riff.
# a Mix: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.5
# b Dirt: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# c Tone: 900 to 4000, default 2200

param a = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
param b = Dirt [1, 5]
param c = Tone [900, 4000]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 180; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
stage1: y = diode(x, b)  # diode clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Vocoder Formant Shift
description: Vocoder as a formant color, self if no sidechain. Voice / synth.
script:
# Vocoder Formant Shift
# How it sounds: Vocoder as a formant color, self if no sidechain. Voice / synth.
# a Formant: 0.6 to 1.6, default 1.05
# b Mix: 0.2 to 1, default 0.55
# c Q: 0.8 to 3.5, default 1.6

param a = Formant [0.6, 1.6]
param b = Mix [0.2, 1]
param c = Q [0.8, 3.5]
vocoder1: bands = 16; formant = a; mix = b; q = c  # vocoder (voice on Sidechain)

name: Vocoder Talk Box
description: Narrower, more mouth. Sidechain voice recommended.
script:
# Vocoder Talk Box
# How it sounds: Narrower, more mouth. Sidechain voice recommended.
# a Formant: 0.7 to 1.8, default 1.2
# b Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.7
# c Tone: 2000 to 7000, default 4500

param a = Formant [0.7, 1.8]
param b = Mix [0.3, 1]
param c = Tone [2000, 7000]
vocoder1: bands = 12; formant = a; mix = b  # vocoder (voice on Sidechain)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Bass Synth Stack
description: Sub octave + fold + LPF. Acid / reese cousin, not Acid Hash.
script:
# Bass Synth Stack
# How it sounds: Sub octave + fold + LPF. Acid / reese cousin, not Acid Hash.
# a Sub: 0.3 to 0.9, default 0.55
# b Fold: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# c Cut: 400 to 2200, default 1100

param a = Sub [0.3, 0.9]
param b = Fold [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Cut [400, 2200]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 140; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
stage1: y = fold(x, -b, b)  # wavefold
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.55  # lowpass

name: Dub Feedback Cave
description: High feedback, dark, then a tiny room. Dub send.
script:
# Dub Feedback Cave
# How it sounds: High feedback, dark, then a tiny room. Dub send.
# a Feedback: 0.35 to 0.72, default 0.52
# b Cave: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.34
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.3

param a = Feedback [0.35, 0.72]
param b = Cave [0.2, 0.55]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
delay1: time = 1/4; feedback = a; mix = 1; damp = 2800  # delay line
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.6; damp = 0.55; mix = 0.25; width = 0.5  # reverb
stage1: y = x * c  # waveshape / mix

name: Vocal Plate Short
description: Bright short plate. Lead vocal send.
script:
# Vocal Plate Short
# How it sounds: Bright short plate. Lead vocal send.
# a Size: 0.12 to 0.35, default 0.2
# b Decay: 0.15 to 0.45, default 0.26
# c Mix: 0.1 to 0.45, default 0.22

param a = Size [0.12, 0.35]
param b = Decay [0.15, 0.45]
param c = Mix [0.1, 0.45]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 200; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.32; mix = c; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: De-Ess Wide
description: Wider de-ess than the vocal one. Podcast / VO.
script:
# De-Ess Wide
# How it sounds: Wider de-ess than the vocal one. Podcast / VO.
# a Ess: 3 to 14, default 7
# b BandHz: 2800 to 6500, default 4000
# c Range: 4 to 12, default 7

param a = Ess [3, 14]
param b = BandHz [2800, 6500]
param c = Range [4, 12]
xover1: f1 = b; f2 = 10000  # crossover
bus high:
  comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = c; attack = 0.0005; release = 0.04  # compressor
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Vocal Opto Soft
description: Softer than optical leveler stock. Low ratio, long release.
script:
# Vocal Opto Soft
# How it sounds: Softer than optical stock. Low ratio, long release.
# a Pull: 3 to 12, default 6.5
# b Release: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# c Makeup: 0 to 6, default 1.8

param a = Pull [3, 12]
param b = Release [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Makeup [0, 6]
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 2; attack = 0.018; release = b; knee = 14; makeup = c  # compressor

name: FET Then Opto
description: FET then opto on one insert. Any source.
script:
# FET Then Opto
# How it sounds: FET then opto on one insert. Any source.
# a Peak: 3 to 12, default 6
# b Ride: 4 to 12, default 7
# c Makeup: 0 to 5, default 1.5

param a = Peak [3, 12]
param b = Ride [4, 12]
param c = Makeup [0, 5]
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 8; attack = 0.0008; release = 0.07; knee = 1; makeup = 2 # compressor
comp2: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.016; release = 0.26; knee = 10; makeup = c # compressor

name: Formant Vowel
description: Two formant peaks. Voice / synth.
script:
# Formant Vowel
# How it sounds: Two formant peaks. Voice / synth.
# a Vowel: 400 to 900, default 600
# b Bright: 0.6 to 1.6, default 1.05
# c Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.65

param a = Vowel [400, 900]
param b = Bright [0.6, 1.6]
param c = Mix [0.3, 1]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus vow:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 180; resonance = 1.4  # bandpass
  filter2: type = bandpass; center = a * b * 2.2; width = 260; resonance = 1.2  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; vow = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Loudness Clip Master
description: Soft-pre clip then limit. Not Loudness Clip stock.
script:
# Loudness Clip Master
# How it sounds: Soft-pre clip then limit. Not Loudness Clip stock.
# a Drive: 0.85 to 1.5, default 1.05
# b Ceiling: -1.2 to -0.15, default -0.4
# c Tone: 8000 to 16000, default 11000

param a = Drive [0.85, 1.5]
param b = Ceiling [-1.2, -0.15]
param c = Tone [8000, 16000]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), 0.92)  # soft clip
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = c; q = 0.5; gain = 0.6  # high shelf
limit1: ceiling = b; release = 0.08  # limiter

name: British Plexi Bark
description: British plexi bark: 800 Hz mid peak, dual tube, cabinet IR.
script:
# British Plexi Bark
# How it sounds: British plexi bark: 800 Hz mid peak, dual tube, cabinet IR.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 7, default 3.4
# b Bark: 2 to 7, default 4
# c Cab: 0.25 to 0.6, default 0.4

param a = Drive [1.5, 7]
param b = Bark [2, 7]
param c = Cab [0.25, 0.6]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 105; resonance = 0.36  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.6)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 800; q = 1.05; gain = b  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = c; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Tweed Edge
description: Small tweed: loose low, early breakup, vintage cab.
script:
# Tweed Edge
# How it sounds: Small tweed: loose low, early breakup, vintage cab.
# a Push: 0.7 to 3.5, default 1.6
# b Loose: 40 to 90, default 55
# c Cab: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.35

param a = Push [0.7, 3.5]
param b = Loose [40, 90]
param c = Cab [0.2, 0.55]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 150; q = 0.7; gain = 2  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = c; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Filter Dist Amp
description: RAT filter into a tube stage + medium cab.
script:
# Filter Dist Amp
# How it sounds: RAT filter into a tube stage + medium cab.
# a Dist: 2 to 10, default 5.5
# b Filter: 500 to 3500, default 1600
# c Amp: 0.8 to 3, default 1.6

param a = Dist [2, 10]
param b = Filter [500, 3500]
param c = Amp [0.8, 3]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3 # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.5), 0.52) # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.58 # lowpass
stage2: y = tube(y, c) # tube saturation
ir1: mix = 0.4; gain = 1 # impulse response

name: Fuzz Into Amp
description: Stacked-filter fuzz into a dark cab.
script:
# Fuzz Into Amp
# How it sounds: Stacked-filter fuzz into a dark cab.
# a Fuzz: 2 to 9, default 5
# b Scoop: 500 to 1200, default 800
# c Cab: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.45

param a = Fuzz [2, 9]
param b = Scoop [500, 1200]
param c = Cab [0.3, 0.7]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.32 # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3800; resonance = 0.4 # lowpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a) # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = b; q = 0.9; gain = -4.5 # peak EQ
ir1: mix = c; gain = 2 # impulse response

name: Crunch Rhythm Pedal
description: Medium crunch, 1.2 kHz, no IR.
script:
# Crunch Rhythm Pedal
# How it sounds: Medium crunch, 1.2 kHz, no IR.
# a Drive: 1.4 to 6, default 3.2
# b Mid: 1 to 5, default 2.6
# c Tone: 2500 to 6500, default 4200

param a = Drive [1.4, 6]
param b = Mid [1, 5]
param c = Tone [2500, 6500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.32  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1200; q = 1.05; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Lead Satin Clip
description: Smoother lead clip + presence, no gate.
script:
# Lead Satin Clip
# How it sounds: Smoother lead clip + presence, no gate.
# a Drive: 1.6 to 7, default 3.5
# b Air: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.1, default 0.75

param a = Drive [1.6, 7]
param b = Air [1, 5]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.1]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 130; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a) * c  # soft clip
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 4200; q = 0.55; gain = b  # high shelf

name: Vocal Tube Desk
description: Vocal: tiny tube, HPF 80, no cab.
script:
# Vocal Tube Desk
# How it sounds: Vocal: tiny tube, HPF 80, no cab.
# a Warm: 0.5 to 2.2, default 1.05
# b Air: 0 to 4, default 1.6
# c Cut: 50 to 140, default 80

param a = Warm [0.5, 2.2]
param b = Air [0, 4]
param c = Cut [50, 140]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 8000; q = 0.5; gain = b  # high shelf

name: Drum Clip Bus
description: Drum bus clip, 80 HPF, 6 kHz LPF.
script:
# Drum Clip Bus
# How it sounds: Drum bus clip, 80 HPF, 6 kHz LPF.
# a Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# b Ceiling: 0.45 to 0.9, default 0.7
# c Top: 3500 to 8000, default 5500

param a = Drive [1, 5]
param b = Ceiling [0.45, 0.9]
param c = Top [3500, 8000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), b)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Mixbus Satin
description: Mixbus: barely-there tube + limit.
script:
# Mixbus Satin
# How it sounds: Mixbus: barely-there tube + limit.
# a Satin: 0.4 to 1.4, default 0.75
# b Ceiling: -1.2 to -0.2, default -0.4
# c Air: 0 to 2, default 0.6

param a = Satin [0.4, 1.4]
param b = Ceiling [-1.2, -0.2]
param c = Air [0, 2]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf
limit1: ceiling = b; release = 0.1  # limiter

name: Lo-Fi Amp Sim
description: Tiny speaker: 300–3.5 kHz + crush.
script:
# Lo-Fi Amp Sim
# How it sounds: Tiny speaker: 300–3.5 kHz + crush.
# a Bits: 5 to 11, default 8
# b Low: 180 to 450, default 280
# c High: 2500 to 5000, default 3500

param a = Bits [5, 11]
param b = Low [180, 450]
param c = High [2500, 5000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.5), a)  # soft clip
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # recovery

name: Hard Clip Club
description: Club clip lighter than Hardcore Clip.
script:
# Hard Clip Club
# How it sounds: Club clip lighter than Hardcore Clip.
# a Drive: 2 to 9, default 5
# b Ceiling: 0.28 to 0.7, default 0.45
# c Top: 3000 to 7000, default 4800

param a = Drive [2, 9]
param b = Ceiling [0.28, 0.7]
param c = Top [3000, 7000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.4), b)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass

name: Gabber Mid Bark
description: Mid bark + sub bus. Not Gabber Drive.
script:
# Gabber Mid Bark
# How it sounds: Mid bark + sub bus. Not Gabber Drive.
# a Bark: 2 to 8, default 4
# b Sub: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.4
# c Drive: 2 to 8, default 4.5

param a = Bark [2, 8]
param b = Sub [0.2, 0.8]
param c = Drive [2, 8]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1400; q = 1.2; gain = a  # peak EQ
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, c * 0.35), 0.4)  # soft clip
bus sub:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
  stage2: y = tube(x, 1.2)  # tube saturation
out: main = 1; sub = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Acid Soft Slide
description: Softer acid than Acid Hash. Env LPF.
script:
# Acid Soft Slide
# How it sounds: Softer acid than Acid Hash. Env LPF.
# a Cut: 250 to 3500, default 900
# b Res: 0.7 to 2.8, default 1.5
# c Env: 200 to 2000, default 800

param a = Cut [250, 3500]
param b = Res [0.7, 2.8]
param c = Env [200, 2000]
env1: attack = 0.005; release = 0.14  # envelope follower
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a + env1 * c; resonance = b  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, 1.3)  # diode clip

name: Industrial Chop
description: Gate + clip. Not Industrial Gate stock.
script:
# Industrial Chop
# How it sounds: Gate + clip. Not Industrial Gate stock.
# a Open: -36 to -14, default -24
# b Drive: 1.5 to 7, default 3.2
# c Hold: 0.01 to 0.08, default 0.03

param a = Open [-36, -14]
param b = Drive [1.5, 7]
param c = Hold [0.01, 0.08]
gate1: threshold = a; hyst = 4; hold = c; range = -70  # noise gate
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.55)  # soft clip
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.28  # recovery

name: Hoover Fold Club
description: Fold + chorus. Not Hoover Dirt.
script:
# Hoover Fold Club
# How it sounds: Fold + chorus. Not Hoover Dirt.
# a Fold: 0.18 to 0.5, default 0.3
# b Rate: 0.2 to 1.5, default 0.55
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.32

param a = Fold [0.18, 0.5]
param b = Rate [0.2, 1.5]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
stage1: y = fold(x, -a, a)  # wavefold
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 11 + osc1 * 6; feedback = 0.08; mix = c; damp = 5000  # delay line

name: Rave Stab Desk
description: Stab: fast env LPF + clip.
script:
# Rave Stab Desk
# How it sounds: Stab: fast env LPF + clip.
# a Cut: 400 to 4000, default 1600
# b Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 2.8
# c Rel: 0.05 to 0.25, default 0.12

param a = Cut [400, 4000]
param b = Drive [1.2, 6]
param c = Rel [0.05, 0.25]
env1: attack = 0.003; release = c  # envelope follower
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a * (0.3 + 0.7 * env1); resonance = 0.8  # lowpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, b)  # soft clip

name: Club Mono Kick
description: Force kick mono below 150 Hz.
script:
# Club Mono Kick
# How it sounds: Force kick mono below 150 Hz.
# a BandHz: 80 to 200, default 140
# b Weight: 0 to 4, default 1.8
# c Click: 0 to 3, default 1.2

param a = BandHz [80, 200]
param b = Weight [0, 4]
param c = Click [0, 3]
xover1: f1 = a  # crossover
bus low:
  eq1: type = peak; freq = 55; q = 1.05; gain = b  # peak EQ
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = side; y = x * 0  # mute this channel
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
eq2: type = peak; freq = 3000; q = 1.2; gain = c  # peak EQ
out: low = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Supersaw Glue
description: Widen + light OTT + clip. Leads / stacks.
script:
# Supersaw Glue
# How it sounds: Widen + light OTT + clip. Leads / stacks.
# a Width: 0.3 to 1, default 0.62
# b Depth: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.3
# c Drive: 0.8 to 2.2, default 1.2

param a = Width [0.3, 1]
param b = Depth [0.15, 0.55]
param c = Drive [0.8, 2.2]
widen1: width = a; delay = 12; bass = 160  # mono to stereo
ott1: depth = b; time = 0.02; in = 1  # OTT (3-band up+down)
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip

name: Drop Impact FX
description: Impact: clip + short verb + click EQ.
script:
# Drop Impact FX
# How it sounds: Impact: clip + short verb + click EQ.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 7, default 3.2
# b Room: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.22
# c Click: 0 to 5, default 2

param a = Drive [1.5, 7]
param b = Room [0.12, 0.4]
param c = Click [0, 5]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), 0.55)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 80; q = 1.2; gain = c  # peak EQ
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.22; damp = 0.45; mix = 0.16; width = 0.5  # reverb

name: Sidechain Pad EDM
description: Four-on-the-floor duck.
script:
# Sidechain Pad EDM
# How it sounds: Four-on-the-floor duck.
# a Depth: 0.35 to 1, default 0.75
# b Release: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2
# c Floor: -24 to -8, default -14

param a = Depth [0.35, 1]
param b = Release [0.1, 0.4]
param c = Floor [-24, -8]
sidechain1: mix = a  # host sidechain
comp1: threshold = c; ratio = 10; attack = 0.001; release = b; makeup = 3; source = sidechain  # compressor
stage1: y = x * 1.25  # makeup

name: Reese Mid Growl
description: Mid grit + chorus. Bass reese.
script:
# Reese Mid Growl
# How it sounds: Mid grit + chorus. Bass reese.
# a Grit: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# b Rate: 0.15 to 1, default 0.4
# c BandHz: 120 to 280, default 180

param a = Grit [1, 5]
param b = Rate [0.15, 1]
param c = BandHz [120, 280]
xover1: f1 = c  # crossover
bus high:
  stage1: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip
  osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
  delay1: time = 12 + osc1 * 5; feedback = 0.06; mix = 0.25; damp = 5000  # delay line
out: low = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Festival Group Vocal
description: Gang vocal: widen + short slap + OTT.
script:
# Festival Group Vocal
# How it sounds: Gang vocal: widen + short slap + OTT.
# a Width: 0.3 to 1, default 0.55
# b Depth: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# c Slap: 70 to 130, default 95

param a = Width [0.3, 1]
param b = Depth [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Slap [70, 130]
widen1: width = a; delay = 14; bass = 180  # mono to stereo
delay1: time = c; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.16; damp = 4500  # delay line
ott1: depth = b; time = 0.02; in = 1  # OTT (3-band up+down)

name: Festival Lead Clip
description: Lead: clip + 3 kHz + widen.
script:
# Festival Lead Clip
# How it sounds: Lead: clip + 3 kHz + widen.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 5, default 2.4
# b Cut: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# c Width: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.45

param a = Drive [1.2, 5]
param b = Cut [1, 5]
param c = Width [0.2, 0.8]
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3000; q = 1.15; gain = b  # peak EQ
widen1: width = c; delay = 11; bass = 200  # mono to stereo

name: Festival Drum Bus
description: EDM drum bus: OTT + clip + HPF.
script:
# Festival Drum Bus
# How it sounds: EDM drum bus: OTT + clip + HPF.
# a Depth: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.38
# b Drive: 1 to 4, default 1.8
# c Cut: 30 to 80, default 45

param a = Depth [0.2, 0.7]
param b = Drive [1, 4]
param c = Cut [30, 80]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
ott1: depth = a; time = 0.015; in = 1.1  # OTT (3-band up+down)
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.72)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # recovery

name: Tape Hiss Bed
description: Dark LPF + wow. Not Cassette.
script:
# Tape Hiss Bed
# How it sounds: Dark LPF + wow. Not Cassette.
# a Top: 2500 to 7000, default 4200
# b Wow: 0.2 to 1, default 0.4
# c Drive: 0.6 to 2, default 1.1

param a = Top [2500, 7000]
param b = Wow [0.2, 1]
param c = Drive [0.6, 2]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 16 + osc1 * 3; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.2; damp = 4000  # delay line
stage1: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: AM Radio Narrow
description: Narrower than Phone Line. 500–2.8 kHz.
script:
# AM Radio Narrow
# How it sounds: Narrower than Phone Line. 500–2.8 kHz.
# a Low: 350 to 700, default 500
# b High: 2000 to 3500, default 2800
# c Bits: 6 to 11, default 8

param a = Low [350, 700]
param b = High [2000, 3500]
param c = Bits [6, 11]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.3), c)  # soft clip
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.28  # recovery

name: VHS Tracking
description: Wow + dark + tiny crush. Video tape.
script:
# VHS Tracking
# How it sounds: Wow + dark + tiny crush. Video tape.
# a Wow: 0.15 to 0.8, default 0.35
# b Bits: 6 to 12, default 9
# c Top: 2000 to 5500, default 3400

param a = Wow [0.15, 0.8]
param b = Bits [6, 12]
param c = Top [2000, 5500]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 20 + osc1 * 4; feedback = 0.1; mix = 0.18; damp = 3500  # delay line
stage1: y = bitcrush(x, b)  # bitcrush
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Broken Speaker
description: 300–2.5 kHz + fold.
script:
# Broken Speaker
# How it sounds: 300–2.5 kHz + fold.
# a Fold: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.22
# b Low: 200 to 450, default 300
# c High: 1800 to 3500, default 2500

param a = Fold [0.12, 0.4]
param b = Low [200, 450]
param c = High [1800, 3500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.42  # lowpass
stage1: y = fold(x, -a, a)  # wavefold
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # recovery

name: Dusty Vinyl Bed
description: Notch + dark + gentle clip. Not Vinyl Dirt.
script:
# Dusty Vinyl Bed
# How it sounds: Notch + dark + gentle clip. Not Vinyl Dirt.
# a Scratch: 400 to 2000, default 900
# b Top: 3000 to 7000, default 4800
# c Dust: 0.6 to 1.8, default 1.05

param a = Scratch [400, 2000]
param b = Top [3000, 7000]
param c = Dust [0.6, 1.8]
eq1: type = notch; freq = a; q = 2.4; gain = -8  # notch
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip

name: Pocket Recorder
description: 8 kHz LPF, light crush, HPF 120.
script:
# Pocket Recorder
# How it sounds: 8 kHz LPF, light crush, HPF 120.
# a Bits: 6 to 12, default 9
# b Top: 4000 to 9000, default 6500
# c Cut: 80 to 200, default 120

param a = Bits [6, 12]
param b = Top [4000, 9000]
param c = Cut [80, 200]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.2), a)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Telephone Then Room
description: Phone band plus a cheap room.
script:
# Telephone Then Room
# How it sounds: Phone band plus a cheap room.
# a Low: 280 to 600, default 400
# b High: 2400 to 4000, default 3200
# c Room: 0.1 to 0.35, default 0.2

param a = Low [280, 600]
param b = High [2400, 4000]
param c = Room [0.1, 0.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
reverb1: size = c; decay = 0.25; damp = 0.45; mix = 0.18; width = 0.4  # reverb

name: Pad Cloud Hall
description: Long hall + slow chorus. Pads.
script:
# Pad Cloud Hall
# How it sounds: Long hall + slow chorus. Pads.
# a Size: 0.45 to 0.88, default 0.66
# b Rate: 0.05 to 0.4, default 0.14
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.36

param a = Size [0.45, 0.88]
param b = Rate [0.05, 0.4]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
reverb1: size = a; decay = 2.4; damp = 0.4; mix = c; width = 0.85  # reverb
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 16 + osc1 * 8; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.2; damp = 6000  # delay line

name: Drone Low Bed
description: Dark drone: LPF + long verb + octave sub.
script:
# Drone Low Bed
# How it sounds: Dark drone: LPF + long verb + octave sub.
# a Sub: 0.1 to 0.5, default 0.25
# b Top: 400 to 1600, default 900
# c Hall: 0.4 to 0.85, default 0.62

param a = Sub [0.1, 0.5]
param b = Top [400, 1600]
param c = Hall [0.4, 0.85]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 120; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass
reverb1: size = c; decay = 2.6; damp = 0.6; mix = 0.4; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Distant Radio Amb
description: Bandpass + long verb. Memory / flashback.
script:
# Distant Radio Amb
# How it sounds: Bandpass + long verb. Memory / flashback.
# a Center: 700 to 1800, default 1100
# b Size: 0.35 to 0.75, default 0.52
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.35

param a = Center [700, 1800]
param b = Size [0.35, 0.75]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 900  # bandpass
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.8; damp = 0.45; mix = c; width = 0.75  # reverb

name: Impact Body Boom
description: Impact: sub bump + short clip. Not Boom Tail.
script:
# Impact Body Boom
# How it sounds: Impact: sub bump + short clip. Not Boom Tail.
# a Sub: 1 to 6, default 3
# b Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# c Room: 0.1 to 0.35, default 0.2

param a = Sub [1, 6]
param b = Drive [1, 5]
param c = Room [0.1, 0.35]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 45; q = 1.2; gain = a  # peak EQ
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.6)  # soft clip
reverb1: size = c; decay = 0.28; damp = 0.55; mix = 0.18; width = 0.45  # reverb

name: Dialogue Phone
description: Phone filter for dialogue. Not Dialogue Seat.
script:
# Dialogue Phone
# How it sounds: Phone filter for dialogue. Not Dialogue Seat.
# a Low: 300 to 700, default 420
# b High: 2500 to 4200, default 3200
# c Grit: 0.5 to 2, default 1

param a = Low [300, 700]
param b = High [2500, 4200]
param c = Grit [0.5, 2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip

name: Tension Pulse
description: Slow trem + dark hall. Not Tension Bed.
script:
# Tension Pulse
# How it sounds: Slow trem + dark hall. Not Tension Bed.
# a Rate: 0.15 to 1.2, default 0.4
# b Size: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.48
# c Depth: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Rate [0.15, 1.2]
param b = Size [0.3, 0.7]
param c = Depth [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (1 - c + c * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.6; damp = 0.55; mix = 0.3; width = 0.65  # reverb

name: Score String Hall
description: Strings: long hall, no octave. Not Score Hall.
script:
# Score String Hall
# How it sounds: Strings: long hall, no octave. Not Score Hall.
# a Size: 0.4 to 0.82, default 0.6
# b Decay: 1.2 to 2.8, default 1.8
# c Mix: 0.18 to 0.5, default 0.3

param a = Size [0.4, 0.82]
param b = Decay [1.2, 2.8]
param c = Mix [0.18, 0.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.42; mix = c; width = 0.8  # reverb

name: Trailer Whoosh
description: HPF sweep + short verb. Whoosh / fly-by.
script:
# Trailer Whoosh
# How it sounds: HPF sweep + short verb. Whoosh / fly-by.
# a Cut: 200 to 2500, default 700
# b Room: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.22
# c Drive: 0.6 to 2.2, default 1.1

param a = Cut [200, 2500]
param b = Room [0.12, 0.4]
param c = Drive [0.6, 2.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.45  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.35; damp = 0.4; mix = 0.22; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Horror Low Drone
description: Sub + dark verb. Horror bed.
script:
# Horror Low Drone
# How it sounds: Sub + dark verb. Horror bed.
# a Sub: 0.15 to 0.6, default 0.32
# b Top: 300 to 1200, default 600
# c Hall: 0.4 to 0.85, default 0.62

param a = Sub [0.15, 0.6]
param b = Top [300, 1200]
param c = Hall [0.4, 0.85]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 100; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass
reverb1: size = c; decay = 2.4; damp = 0.7; mix = 0.38; width = 0.6  # reverb
stage1: y = x * 2.4  # makeup

name: Dialogue Air Seat
description: Dialogue: HPF 80, air, tiny booth.
script:
# Dialogue Air Seat
# How it sounds: Dialogue: HPF 80, air, tiny booth.
# a Air: 0 to 4, default 1.6
# b Cut: 60 to 140, default 85
# c Booth: 0.08 to 0.25, default 0.14

param a = Air [0, 4]
param b = Cut [60, 140]
param c = Booth [0.08, 0.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 8000; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf
reverb1: size = 0.16; decay = c; damp = 0.48; mix = 0.12; width = 0.35  # reverb

name: Glitch Hold Gate
description: Choppy gate, 1/16. Not Glitch Gate.
script:
# Glitch Hold Gate
# How it sounds: Choppy gate, 1/16. Not Glitch Gate.
# a Depth: 0.5 to 1, default 0.85
# b Open: -30 to -8, default -18
# c Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.8

param a = Depth [0.5, 1]
param b = Open [-30, -8]
param c = Mix [0.3, 1]
osc1: shape = square; freq = 1/16; depth = 1  # LFO
gate1: threshold = b; hyst = 3; hold = 0.01; range = -70  # noise gate
stage1: y = lerp(x, x * (1 - a + a * (0.05 + 0.95 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))), c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Alien Formant
description: Moving formant. Not Alien Ring.
script:
# Alien Formant
# How it sounds: Moving formant. Not Alien Ring.
# a Rate: 0.1 to 2, default 0.45
# b Center: 400 to 1400, default 800
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.55

param a = Rate [0.1, 2]
param b = Center [400, 1400]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.9]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus mouth:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = b + osc1 * 400; width = 220; resonance = 1.5  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; mouth = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Ring Then Verb
description: Ring mod into a hall.
script:
# Ring Then Verb
# How it sounds: Ring mod into a hall.
# a Freq: 50 to 300, default 110
# b Size: 0.25 to 0.65, default 0.42
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.35

param a = Freq [50, 300]
param b = Size [0.25, 0.65]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = lerp(x, x * osc1, 0.55)  # dry/wet blend
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.1; damp = 0.4; mix = c; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Cascade Taps
description: Three delay times stacked. Not Cascade Loop Dirt.
script:
# Cascade Taps
# How it sounds: Three delay times stacked. Not Cascade Loop Dirt.
# a Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# b Feedback: 0.08 to 0.3, default 0.16
# c Tone: 2500 to 7000, default 4200

param a = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
param b = Feedback [0.08, 0.3]
param c = Tone [2500, 7000]
delay1: time = 1/16; feedback = b; mix = a * 0.5; damp = c  # delay line
delay2: time = 1/8; feedback = b; mix = a * 0.4; damp = c  # delay line
delay3: time = 1/4; feedback = b * 0.8; mix = a * 0.35; damp = c  # delay line

name: Impact Designer
description: Design hits: clip, sub, short room.
script:
# Impact Designer
# How it sounds: Design hits: clip, sub, short room.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 7, default 3
# b Sub: 0 to 6, default 2.4
# c Room: 0.08 to 0.32, default 0.16

param a = Drive [1.2, 7]
param b = Sub [0, 6]
param c = Room [0.08, 0.32]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), 0.55)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 50; q = 1.3; gain = b  # peak EQ
reverb1: size = c; decay = 0.2; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.15; width = 0.4  # reverb

name: Texture Crush
description: Crush + bandpass. Texture layer.
script:
# Texture Crush
# How it sounds: Crush + bandpass. Texture layer.
# a Bits: 4 to 10, default 7
# b Center: 400 to 2000, default 900
# c Width: 200 to 1200, default 500

param a = Bits [4, 10]
param b = Center [400, 2000]
param c = Width [200, 1200]
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.4), a)  # soft clip
filter1: type = bandpass; center = b; width = c  # bandpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8000; resonance = 0.25  # recovery

name: Sub Drop FX
description: Octave sub + clip. Drop FX.
script:
# Sub Drop FX
# How it sounds: Octave sub + clip. Drop FX.
# a Sub: 0.3 to 0.9, default 0.55
# b Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# c Top: 80 to 200, default 130

param a = Sub [0.3, 0.9]
param b = Drive [1, 5]
param c = Top [80, 200]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 90; thresh = 0.04  # analog octaver
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.65)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
stage2: y = x * 6.2  # makeup

name: Glitch Buffer
description: Tiny delay, square AM. Buffer glitch.
script:
# Glitch Buffer
# How it sounds: Tiny delay, square AM. Buffer glitch.
# a Time: 6 to 30, default 14
# b Rate: 4 to 16, default 8
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.5

param a = Time [6, 30]
param b = Rate [4, 16]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
osc1: shape = square; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.25; mix = c; damp = 6000  # delay line
stage1: y = x * (0.2 + 0.8 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix

name: Acoustic Body
description: Adds low-mid body to piezo and thin acoustics.
script:
# Acoustic Body
# How it sounds: Adds low-mid body to piezo and thin acoustics.
# a Body: 120 to 600, default 280
# b Res: 0.4 to 2.2, default 1.1

param a = Body [120.0, 600.0]
param b = Res [0.4, 2.2]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 500; resonance = b  # filter1: bandpass
stage1: y = x + y_prev * 0.08  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter2: lowpass

name: Arp Shimmer
description: Sparkle for arpeggios and sequences.
script:
# Arp Shimmer
# How it sounds: Sparkle for arpeggios and sequences.
# a Sparkle: 4000 to 16000, default 10000

param a = Sparkle [4000.0, 16000.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 2.5; depth = 1.0  # osc1: LFO
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.6  # filter1: highpass
stage1: y = x + osc1 * 0.03  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Bitcrush Glitch
description: Digital glitch and bit reduction.
script:
# Bitcrush Glitch
# How it sounds: Digital glitch and bit reduction.
# a Bits: 2 to 12, default 5

param a = Bits [2.0, 12.0]
osc1: shape = saw; freq = 3000; depth = 1.0  # osc1: LFO
stage1: y = bitcrush(x + osc1 * 0.05, a)  # stage1: bitcrush
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter1: lowpass

name: Blues Break OD
description: Warm mid-forward overdrive for single coils.
script:
# Blues Break OD
# How it sounds: Warm mid-forward overdrive for single coils.
# a Drive: 0.2 to 5, default 2.2
# b Tone: 400 to 8000, default 2800

param a = Drive [0.2, 5.0]
param b = Tone [400.0, 8000.0]
stage1: y = tanh(x * a + 0.05) # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.7 # filter1: lowpass

name: Chug Palm Mute
description: Punchy low-mid for rhythm riffs.
script:
# Chug Palm Mute
# How it sounds: Punchy low-mid for rhythm riffs.
# a Punch: 1 to 10, default 5
# b Low: 80 to 400, default 160
# c Gate: 0.02 to 0.4, default 0.1

param a = Punch [1.0, 10.0]
param b = Low [80.0, 400.0]
param c = Gate [0.02, 0.4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = b; q = 1.6; gain = 6  # peak EQ
stage1: y = hardclip(x * a, 0.55) * (0.2 + 0.8 * step(c * 0.12, abs(x)))  # hard clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Dark Atmosphere
description: Low ominous atmosphere layer.
script:
# Dark Atmosphere
# How it sounds: Low ominous atmosphere layer.
# a Dark: 40 to 300, default 110

param a = Dark [40.0, 300.0]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 500; resonance = 1.1  # filter1: lowpass
stage1: y = x * 0.3 + noise(t * sr) * 0.22 + y_prev * 0.15  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter2: lowpass

name: Drum Bus Glue
description: Gentle bus compression for cohesion.
script:
# Drum Bus Glue
# How it sounds: Gentle bus compression for cohesion.
# a Threshold: -24 to -6, default -14
# b Ratio: 1.5 to 6, default 2.5

param a = Threshold [-24.0, -6.0]
param b = Ratio [1.5, 6.0]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.003; release = 0.09  # comp1: compressor
stage1: y = x * (1.0 + 0.1)  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Harmonic Exciter
description: Exciter-Charakter über Filter + Sättigung.
script:
# Harmonic Exciter
# How it sounds: Exciter-Charakter über Filter + Sättigung.
# a Drive: 0.5 to 6, default 2.2
# b HighFreq: 1500 to 14000, default 5500
# c Amount: 0 to 1, default 0.55

param a = Drive [0.5, 6.0]
param b = HighFreq [1500.0, 14000.0]
param c = Amount [0.0, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.8  # filter1: highpass
stage1: y = x + tanh(x * a) * c  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 18000; resonance = 0.7  # filter2: lowpass

name: Loudness Safe
description: Controlled saturation with soft clip ceiling.
script:
# Loudness Safe
# How it sounds: Controlled saturation with soft clip ceiling.
# a Drive: 0.5 to 4, default 1.8
# b Ceiling: 0.5 to 1, default 0.92

param a = Drive [0.5, 4.0]
param b = Ceiling [0.5, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.5  # filter1: highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(tanh(x * a), b)  # stage1: hard clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter2: lowpass

name: Low End Control
description: Tames boomy low end on mixes.
script:
# Low End Control
# How it sounds: Tames boomy low end on mixes.
# a Freq: 30 to 150, default 80

param a = Freq [30.0, 150.0]
comp1: threshold = -16; ratio = 3.5; attack = 0.02; release = 0.22  # compressor
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = a; q = 0.7; gain = -5  # low shelf
stage1: y = tanh(x * 1.2)  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 14000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Metal Scoop
description: Tight high-gain with scooped mids.
script:
# Metal Scoop
# How it sounds: Tight high-gain with scooped mids.
# a Gain: 2 to 14, default 8
# b Presence: 2000 to 12000, default 5200
# c Gate: 0.01 to 0.35, default 0.07

param a = Gain [2.0, 14.0]
param b = Presence [2000.0, 12000.0]
param c = Gate [0.01, 0.35]
stage1: y = hardclip(x * a, 0.55) * step(c, abs(x))  # stage1: hard clip
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.6  # filter1: highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5  # filter2: lowpass

name: Pick Attack
description: Enhances pick/pluck transients.
script:
# Pick Attack
# How it sounds: Enhances pick/pluck transients.
# a Attack: 0.0005 to 0.006, default 0.0022

param a = Attack [0.5, 6.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 2; release = 0.09  # env1: envelope follower
stage1: y = x * (1.0 + env1 * a + 0.1)  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Pluck Bite
description: Short transient emphasis for plucks.
script:
# Pluck Bite
# How it sounds: Short transient emphasis for plucks.
# a Bite: 0.5 to 5, default 2.2

param a = Bite [0.5, 5.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 1; release = 0.055  # env1: envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.7  # filter1: highpass
stage1: y = x * (1.0 + env1 * a * 0.2)  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Podcast Voice
description: Broadcast-style compression and tone.
script:
# Podcast Voice
# How it sounds: Broadcast-style compression and tone.
# a Comp: 2 to 10, default 4.5
# b LowCut: 60 to 250, default 120

param a = Comp [2.0, 10.0]
param b = LowCut [60.0, 250.0]
comp1: threshold = -18; ratio = a; attack = 0.006; release = 0.14  # comp1: compressor
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.6  # filter1: highpass
stage1: y = tanh(x * 1.1)  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Riff Sustain
description: Singing sustain for leads.
script:
# Riff Sustain
# How it sounds: Singing sustain for leads.
# a Sustain: 0.001 to 0.008, default 0.0035
# b Comp: 1.5 to 8, default 3

param a = Sustain [1.0, 8.0]
param b = Comp [1.5, 8.0]
comp1: threshold = -20; ratio = b; attack = 0.008; release = 0.18  # comp1: compressor
stage1: y = tanh(x * a)  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3200; resonance = 0.8  # filter1: lowpass

name: Sub Weight
description: Adds controlled sub and tight low end.
script:
# Sub Weight
# How it sounds: Adds controlled sub and tight low end.
# a Sub: 40 to 180, default 90
# b Drive: 0.5 to 4, default 1.6

param a = Sub [40.0, 180.0]
param b = Drive [0.5, 4.0]
comp1: threshold = -22; ratio = 4; attack = 0.012; release = 0.2  # compressor
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = a; q = 0.8; gain = 4.5  # low shelf
stage1: y = tanh(x * b)  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Tape Wobble
description: Slow pitch/wow flutter.
script:
# Tape Wobble
# How it sounds: Slow pitch/wow flutter.
# a Wow: 0.1 to 3, default 0.6

param a = Wow [0.1, 3.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # osc1: LFO
stage1: y = x + y_prev * 0.12 + osc1 * 0.04  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter1: lowpass

name: Telephone EQ
description: Bandpass 300-3400 Hz für Telefoncharakter.
script:
# Telephone EQ
# How it sounds: Bandpass 300-3400 Hz für Telefoncharakter.
# a LowCut: 120 to 500, default 300
# b HighCut: 2500 to 5000, default 3400
# c Drive: 0.8 to 2, default 1.1
# d Res: 0.3 to 1.2, default 0.6

param a = LowCut [120.0, 500.0]
param b = HighCut [2500.0, 5000.0]
param c = Drive [0.8, 2.0]
param d = Res [0.3, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = d  # filter1: highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = d  # filter2: lowpass
stage1: y = tanh(x * c)  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Vocal De-Ess
description: Tames harsh sibilance.
script:
# Vocal De-Ess
# How it sounds: Tames harsh sibilance.
# a Freq: 4000 to 12000, default 7800
# b Depth: 0 to 1, default 0.6

param a = Freq [4000.0, 12000.0]
param b = Depth [0.0, 1.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 1; release = 0.04  # env1: envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.7  # filter1: highpass
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - env1 * b * 0.35)  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Vocal Double
description: Subtle detune/double thickness.
script:
# Vocal Double
# How it sounds: Subtle detune/double thickness.
# a Detune: 0 to 0.4, default 0.12
# b DelayFb: 0 to 0.6, default 0.22
# c Blend: 0 to 1, default 0.45

param a = Detune [0.0, 0.4]
param b = DelayFb [0.0, 0.6]
param c = Blend [0.0, 1.0]
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - c) + (x + y_prev * b + a * 0.05) * c  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter1: lowpass

name: Vocal Presence
description: Adds clarity and forward presence.
script:
# Vocal Presence
# How it sounds: Adds clarity and forward presence.
# a Presence: 1500 to 8000, default 4200
# b Amount: 0 to 1, default 0.55

param a = Presence [1500.0, 8000.0]
param b = Amount [0.0, 1.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 900; resonance = 1.0  # filter1: bandpass
stage1: y = x + tanh(x) * b * 0.25  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Vocal Warmth
description: Gentle low-mid warmth for thin voices.
script:
# Vocal Warmth
# How it sounds: Gentle low-mid warmth for thin voices.
# a Warmth: 200 to 900, default 420
# b Soft: 0 to 1, default 0.5

param a = Warmth [200.0, 900.0]
param b = Soft [0.0, 1.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 500; resonance = 0.8  # filter1: bandpass
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - b) + tanh(x) * b  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Vowel Filter
description: Zwei Bandpässe formen vokalähnliche Spektren.
script:
# Vowel Filter
# How it sounds: Zwei Bandpässe formen vokalähnliche Spektren.
# a Vowel: 0 to 1, default 0.35
# b Spread: 200 to 2000, default 800
# c Res: 0.5 to 3, default 1.5

param a = Vowel [0.0, 1.0]
param b = Spread [200.0, 2000.0]
param c = Res [0.5, 3.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = 500; + = a; * = 1700; width = b  # filter1: bandpass
stage1: y = x * 1.45  # waveshape / mix  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter2: type = bandpass; center = 1100; + = a; * = 0.7; width = b  # filter2: bandpass
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter3: lowpass
